query:
DELETE FROM results
        WHERE repo_id = $1
          AND (format_version <> $2 OR id NOT IN (
              SELECT id FROM (
                  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sha) id, created_at
                  FROM results
                  WHERE repo_id = $1 AND format_version = $2
                  ORDER BY sha, created_at DESC, id DESC
              ) AS newest
              ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
              LIMIT (
                  SELECT GREATEST(1, (value #>> '{}')::bigint)
                  FROM settings WHERE key = 'results_kept_per_repo'
              )
          ))
